headline: DET @ CLE matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is DET 3.20 at CLE 2.74, with a projected total of 5.94. Movement read: Both offenses moved down (DET -0.65, CLE -0.63), so the movement points more toward run suppression than a clearer side. The projected total fell -1.28, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +12.2%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Casey Mize has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.0 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Gleyber Torres, José Ramírez, Kevin McGonigle, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Jahmai Jones, David Fry because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
